test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

His deliberate activities brought him __**fame**__.
solution: The correct answer is **"Dishonour."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ ** __ • **"Fame"** means being known or talked about by many people because of what you have achieved. (यश, प्रसिद्धि) • **Example**: *Pop stars achieve **fame**__ at a young age.* • The antonym of** "fame"** is** "dishonour."** • **"Dishonour"** means the state of no longer being respected, especially because you have done something bad. (कुछ ग़लत कर जाने के कारण सम्मानीय न रह जाने की स्थिति, बेइज़्ज़ती, अपयश) __ • **Example**: *Her illegal trading has brought **dishonour**__ on the company.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, Respect** means to admire or hold in high esteem. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति आदर-भावना) • **Option 3, Sorrow** means sadness or grief. (गहरी खिन्‍नता, दुख, उदासी (अप्रिय घटना के कारण)) • **Option 4, Strength** means power or ability. (शारीरिक बल, शक्ति, ताक़त; किसी में शारीरिक बल या शक्ति की मात्रा) 41:Tc0d, The correct answer is **"Distant."**
